the meaning of sensory stimuli is constructed in the brain as a result of the dynamics of the brain's intrinsic oscillations.

the brain functions as a nonlinear dynamical system, that it operates hierarchically, that it is a self organized system, and that it constructs meaning from the dynamics of the mass action of large populations of neurons.
